# Every example generates for html in route mode, the way the Pokédex README's
# first command does, which no test did: a `$"…"` placeholder reads the
# locale a context holds rather than state, and a route refused it as neither
# literal nor reactive; a measurement literal, a canvas's `width=400px`, was
# refused as no literal it could spell. Run from the repository, since
# http-session imports a Go package of its module.
cd $SNGL_ROOT
sngl generate --platform html --lang go -o $WORK/out/calculator ./examples/calculator
exists $WORK/out/calculator/server.go
sngl generate --platform html --lang go -o $WORK/out/canvas ./examples/canvas
exists $WORK/out/canvas/server.go
sngl generate --platform html --lang go -o $WORK/out/hello-i18n ./examples/hello-i18n
exists $WORK/out/hello-i18n/server.go
sngl generate --platform html --lang go -o $WORK/out/hello ./examples/hello
exists $WORK/out/hello/server.go
sngl generate --platform html --lang go -o $WORK/out/http-session ./examples/http-session
exists $WORK/out/http-session/server.go
sngl generate --platform html --lang go -o $WORK/out/pokedex ./examples/pokedex
exists $WORK/out/pokedex/server.go
sngl generate --platform html --lang go -o $WORK/out/showcase ./examples/showcase
exists $WORK/out/showcase/server.go
sngl generate --platform html --lang go -o $WORK/out/todo ./examples/todo
exists $WORK/out/todo/server.go
